The '''''Krayt's Honor''''' was a modified [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] owned by the [[Kel Dor]] [[Siqo Vass]] prior to the [[Clone Wars]]. It attained notoriety for protecting [[merchant]] [[Starship|ships]] and shipping companies in the [[Outer Rim Territories]], who would often be raided by [[pirate]]s hired by the [[Trade Federation]].

==Description==
Modified by its owner, [[Siqo Vass]], the ''Krayt's Honor'' looked like any other [[Gozanti-class cruiser|''Gozanti''-class cruiser]] from the outside. However, it was equipped with a military-class [[deflector shield generator]] and illegal weaponry, including eight [[laser turret]]s, two [[proton torpedo launcher]]s, two [[quad laser cannon]]s, and three [[turbolaser]]s. Its [[sublight engine]] was also upgraded clandestinely. Its upgrades enabled the ''Krayt's Honor'' to go up against far bigger [[starship]]s.<ref name="Walkers and Ground Vehicles" />

==History==
===Early contracts===
Long before the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic]],<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> the ''Krayt's Honor'' was used by the [[Kel Dor]] Siqo Vass and his crew to offer protection contracts to shipping companies and [[merchant]] ships in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. Vass's aid was particularly valuable, as the [[Trade Federation]] was known to send [[pirate]]s after their rivals. Due to their actions, the ''Krayt's Honor'' was constantly pursued by [[bounty hunter]]s of the Trade Federation and found itself cornered at every turn, until it ran into a stroke of luck.<ref name="Walkers and Ground Vehicles" />

===A stroke of luck===
At some point prior to the Clone Wars, the crew of the ''Krayt's Honor'' took on a contract to defend a luxury [[yacht]] against a pirate attack. After repelling the attack, Vass and his men found out that they had been protecting the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] from an attack by one of his rivals. The Hutt, thankful, offered the the crew of the ''Krayt's Honor'' refuge on [[Tatooine]]. Under Jabba's protection, very few [[bounty]] hunters went after the ''Krayt's Honor'' again.<ref name="Walkers and Ground Vehicles" /> In both [[32 BBY]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="tpm">{{Film|I}}</ref> and [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the [[cruiser]] was present in the [[spaceport]] of [[Mos Espa]].<ref name="AotC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Gozanti.png|thumb|right|200px|The ''Krayt's Honor'', as it appeared in ''Star Wars'' Legends]]
The ''Krayt's Honor'' first appeared, albeit unnamed, in {{Film|I}}.<ref name="tpm" /> The cruiser was identified in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 34|34th]] issue of ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'',<ref name="BMF">{{BuildFalconCite|34|Starship Fact File}}</ref> which was released on [[August 26]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BuildFalconDates|34}}</ref> Its backstory was later expanded upon in [[Walkers and Ground Vehicles of the Empire and First Order]],<ref name="Walkers and Ground Vehicles" /> a booklet in a series of [[canon]] reference booklets titled the [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']], published on [[May 11]], [[2021]].<ref name="Altaya">{{Altaya|lang=fr|url=livres-bd/encyclopedie-star-wars|text=Official Star Wars Encyclopedia}}</ref>

The [[cruiser]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was identified in a [[2006]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry,<ref name="DB">{{DB|starship|kraytshonor|Krayt's Honor}}</ref> and its backstory was elaborated upon by "[[KenobiDX67]]" through [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]]"<ref name="What's the Story">[[What's The Story?]]</ref>
